## Description

## Downloading data from GEE

```{.javascript}
// Area of interest
var aoi = ee.FeatureCollection('projects/ee-vernier/assets/caribou_aoi').geometry();

var dataset = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/COMPOSITES/C02/T1_L2_ANNUAL_NDVI')
                  .filterDate('2020-01-01', '2025-12-31');
var ndvi = dataset.select('NDVI').mosaic().clip(aoi);
var ndviVis = {
  min: 0,
  max: 1,
  palette: [
    'ffffff', 'ce7e45', 'df923d', 'f1b555', 'fcd163', '99b718', '74a901',
    '66a000', '529400', '3e8601', '207401', '056201', '004c00', '023b01',
    '012e01', '011d01', '011301'
  ],
};

Map.centerObject(aoi, 8);
Map.addLayer(ndvi, ndviVis, 'NDVI');

Export.image.toDrive({
  image: ndvi,
  folder: 'gee_data',
  description: 'ndvi_2020-25',
  maxPixels: 1e13,
  crs: 'EPSG:3578',
  scale: 100,
  region: aoi
});
```
